baseline_models.focus_anchor: The fronted destination in `إلى ربك` joins the definite event noun `الرجعى`.
baseline_models.mechanism: The return branch moves what has gone out back to a prior holder or state, while the lordship branch identifies that endpoint as owner and authority. Return is therefore a reversion of custody and jurisdiction, not merely travel toward a place.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and authority make the Lord the rightful holder to whom all apparent autonomy reverts.
Return or sending back supplies the movement of restoration to that holder.

changed_reading.before: There will eventually be a return in the Lord's direction.
changed_reading.after: Every temporary claim of possession or independence is destined to revert to the Lord's already-existing authority.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: `ربك` can name the one who nurtures and completes, and `الرجعى` can restore a prior condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: The destination is not only sovereign but the one who has been bringing the addressed creature stage by stage toward completion. The return can therefore complete or restore a formative relation rather than simply transfer a subject to a tribunal.

activation_trace.role: Nurture, repair, and completion make the Lord the continuing agent of formation.
Recovery of a former or better condition lets return function as restoration under that care.

changed_reading.before: Return is relocation to a final authority.
changed_reading.after: Return is also the creature's re-entry into the care and completion from which its development never became independent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: `الرجعى` carries a reply branch, and its answer is directed `إلى ربك`.
baseline_models.mechanism: A returned answer converts motion back to the Lord into answerability: what issued into action or speech comes back as a response before authority.

activation_trace.role: Lordship supplies the authoritative addressee and evaluator of the returned response.
A reply returned to its addressee turns return into responsive accounting.

changed_reading.before: A person is brought back to the Lord.
changed_reading.after: A person's deeds and claims come back as an answer that must be rendered to the Lord.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus combines an abiding `رب` with branch images of recurrent `رجع`.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord remains while rain, sound, and other motions recur. This permits a cyclical model in which return is not exhausted by one terminal transfer: repeated movements continually feed back toward an abiding source.

activation_trace.role: Staying, clinging, and duration supply the stable pole around which returns recur.
Recurrent water supplies a material cycle of going out and coming back.
Returning sound supplies a second, auditory form of recurrence around the stable endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The return is a single event at the end of a line.
changed_reading.after: The final return remains live, but it crowns repeated feedbacks to an abiding Lord already occurring within the line.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recitation, an identifying name or mark, measured creation, Lord-formed knowledge, and the writing instrument form an authorship-to-inscription chain. The reply branch of `الرجعى` closes that chain as readback: formed and taught life returns legible to its source.

activation_trace.role: A returned reply gives the focus return a channel of readback rather than bare relocation.
Reading and recitation supply voiced or legible material capable of being returned.
The split mapping's visible identifying mark lets the name participate as inscription.
Lord-formed knowledge identifies the named Lord as the chain's teaching source.
Measured formation supplies an authored design rather than an unstructured beginning.
An identifying sign makes taught knowledge readable as evidence.
The sharpened writing instrument materializes the inscription and readback mechanism.

structural_cues: 96:1-5 advances from repeated reading through creation and teaching to the pen before 96:8 reverses the vector toward `ربك`.
The exact command `اقرأ` recurs at 96:1 and 96:3, while `ربك` recurs there and in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, marking, measured formation, teaching, and writing; I infer that they form one authorship-and-readback circuit closed by return. A live alternative is that these are separate benefactions and that `الرجعى` retains only personal or eschatological motion.

changed_reading.before: Return as reply means that a person must answer to authority.
changed_reading.after: The answer is the creature's read, taught, marked, and enacted life returned as a legible readback to its authoring Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human begins in attachment and under nurture, then judges itself self-sufficient. Return restores the relation that the independence claim concealed: the dependent is brought back into manifest dependence on the sustaining Lord.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion anchor the destination as the sustainer of an unfinished dependent.
Restoration of condition makes return the recovery of a denied creaturely relation.
The same nurturing title at the opening links the creature's beginning and endpoint.
Clinging and dependence supply the human's originating relational condition.
Claimed self-sufficiency attempts to sever the relation that return restores.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from creation `من علق` at 96:2 to reflexive self-sufficiency at 96:7, immediately followed by the focus.
The possessive `ربك` occurs at both the opening origin and the stated destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attachment, nurture, and a later claim of sufficiency; I infer a dependency arc in which return exposes rather than creates dependence. Alternatively, attachment may describe only origin and self-sufficiency only a moral delusion, leaving return purely juridical.

changed_reading.before: Return completes a generally nurturing trajectory.
changed_reading.after: Return specifically reverses the fiction of self-sufficiency and makes original dependence on the nurturer visible again.

context_deltas.mechanism: Self-sufficiency produces boundary-crossing like rising, sweeping water. The focus roots also carry collected and recurrent water, allowing return to appear as the counter-movement in which overflow is made to recede into a containing source.

activation_trace.role: Abundant collected water supplies a contained reservoir at the Lordward endpoint.
Returning water supplies the receding or cycling motion back toward containment.
Rising, sweeping water turns transgression into a material overflow beyond bounds.
The sufficiency claim supplies the pressure that the reader links to overflow.

structural_cues: 96:6-8 forms a tight sequence: human overflow, its self-sufficiency premise, then emphatic Lordward return.
The emphatic `إن` of 96:6 is answered by the emphatic `إن` of 96:8.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overflow, recurrent water, collected water, and self-sufficiency; I supply the hydraulic arrow from swelling beyond bounds to receding containment. The live alternative is the ordinary moral-juridical reading with no ecological mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Return corrects rebellion by restoring jurisdiction.
changed_reading.after: Return is also the countercurrent of transgression: self-swollen overflow is receded and recollected into the source it could not exceed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human first issues a self-verdict of sufficiency; repeated demands to see interrupt that verdict; lying then stands under disclosed divine sight. Return as reply becomes evidentiary: the self-authored view comes back for correction under the Lord's seeing.

activation_trace.role: Authority gives the returned evidence a competent evaluator.
The returned answer lets perception and claim come back as testimony.
The heart's opinion supplies the self-assessing judgment that will be reviewed.
The first alerting `have you seen` reopens what self-perception treated as settled.
The repeated inquiry keeps the conduct under examination.
The third inquiry forces the competing moral possibilities back into view.
Contradiction of truth supplies the claim whose evidentiary return matters.
Disclosure to a knower makes the concealed conduct available for judgment.
Divine seeing replaces self-certification with an encompassing witness.

structural_cues: Self-seeing at 96:7 is followed by three `أرأيت` prompts and closes with `الله يرى` at 96:14.
The focus stands between the self-verdict and the sustained cross-examination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-assessment, repeated visual interrogation, falsehood, disclosure, and divine sight; I infer an evidentiary circuit in which the gaze itself returns for review. Alternatively, the questions may only be rhetoric and return may concern persons rather than perceptions or claims.

changed_reading.before: The person returns to give an answer.
changed_reading.after: The person's very way of seeing and self-acquitting returns as evidence beneath the Lord's counter-gaze.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root first names one person's attempt to stop another and later demands that the stopper reach a stop. The return statement between them becomes a reversal operator: coercive arrest rebounds into the coercer's own terminus under higher authority.

activation_trace.role: Lordship establishes the superior jurisdiction that reverses the attempted prohibition.
Sending back supplies the reversal that turns an imposed stop upon its agent.
Forbidding and checking action identify the coercion initially directed outward.
The endpoint at which a thing stops turns that coercive root back into the agent's own limit.

structural_cues: `ينهى` at 96:9 and `ينته` at 96:15 place the same root on opposite sides of the confrontation.
The focus precedes the first detailed scene, functioning as a governing reversal claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward prohibition and later required cessation with an endpoint branch; I infer that root repetition intentionally redirects the stopping force toward its agent. A live alternative is that the two forms are ordinary separate uses with no rebound mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The arrogant actor will eventually be returned to the Lord.
changed_reading.after: His attempt to stop another already carries its own return: the stopper is driven to his limit by the authority he tried to displace.

context_deltas.mechanism: Worship, prayer, guidance, and protective orientation define a traversable route, while turning away defines its competing direction. The focus return can thus be enacted as turning back from a course and reorienting toward the nurturing Lord, without cancelling the final return.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion make the destination one toward which conduct can be re-formed.
Turning back from an act supplies moral course correction inside the larger return.
Humble worship supplies the subject's chosen orientation toward the true authority.
The specified act of worship makes that orientation embodied and repeatable.
Gentle direction toward a road or truth supplies a navigable Lordward course.
Placing oneself within protection gives the course a preventive, self-reorienting function.
Turning away supplies the opposed vector that return can reverse.

structural_cues: 96:11-13 poses a live fork: being upon guidance and commanding protection versus denying and turning away.
The worshipper of 96:10 remains the grammatical object of attempted obstruction, so route and counter-route are socially contested.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies worship, a guided road, protective orientation, and turning away; I infer that `الرجعى` can include present course correction as well as final arrival. Alternatively, these actions may describe obedience while return remains wholly future and involuntary.

changed_reading.before: Return is an unavoidable endpoint imposed on every course.
changed_reading.after: Return is also a direction one can inhabit now by turning from the wrong course into worship, guidance, and protective alignment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prohibitor summons his assembly; a counter-summons calls agents of seizure and repulsion; the body is taken by its forelock. Sovereign return becomes an executed transfer of custody, while returned reply becomes a call answered by a stronger call.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and authority make the physical retrieval an execution of superior custody.
A returned answer lets the rival summons receive a concrete counter-answer.
Taking by the forelock converts return from abstraction into bodily retrieval.
The forelock as grasp point locates where custody is physically asserted.
Calling by speech initiates the prohibitor's attempt to mobilize counter-authority.
The gathered council supplies the social body on which the prohibitor relies.
The answering call mirrors and overmatches the first summons.
Pushing, striking, and preventing give the counter-summons enforcement force.

structural_cues: `فليدع ناديه` and `سندع الزبانية` form a balanced summons and counter-summons at 96:17-18.
The forelock is introduced at 96:15 and repeated as the described bearer of falsehood and error at 96:16.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored calls, a gathered council, seizure by the forelock, and repelling force; I infer a custody-transfer sequence that executes the focus return. Alternatively, the threats may only illustrate punishment after return rather than define return's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Sovereign return is a general future reversion of jurisdiction.
changed_reading.after: The local confrontation stages that reversion as a counter-summons that seizes the claimant and transfers him out of his council's protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: Refusal of false obedience, bodily lowering, and approach form a present sequence of reorientation. The final command turns the future Lordward return into something voluntarily pre-enacted now, with the spatial paradox that lowering rather than self-elevation produces nearness.

activation_trace.role: Abiding and drawing near make the Lordward endpoint available as present relation.
Turning back from a prior course supplies the reorientation performed by the imperatives.
Obedient yielding, here negated toward the prohibitor, clears the rival directional claim.
Bodily lowering and humility enact chosen submission to the true authority.
Nearness supplies immediate arrival within the larger Lordward return.

structural_cues: The closing verse gives three linked imperatives: do not obey him, prostrate, and draw near.
The final motion toward nearness follows a downward bodily act, reversing the earlier imagery of transgressive rising.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies refusal, lowering, and approach; I infer that these actions pre-enact the focus return as present voluntary orientation. A live alternative is that they are devotional responses to the threat while `الرجعى` remains exclusively the unavoidable final event.

changed_reading.before: All are returned to the Lord eventually, whether willing or unwilling.
changed_reading.after: The worshipper begins that return willingly now: false obedience is refused, the body lowers, and Lordward nearness is entered before the final return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because repeated sound is a peripheral branch beside the ordinary return sense. It remains anchored in the focus root and is activated by the exact doubled command to read; downstream prose should present it as a sonic performance of return, not as a replacement translation of `الرجعى`.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated-sound branch of focus `ر ج ع` can be activated without moving the return away from `ربك`.

activation_trace.role: Reverberating sound makes return audible as an echo or repeated recitation.
Lord-formed knowledge gives the repeated utterance a teaching source to which it can answer.
The first recitation launches the sound whose recurrence can enact return.
The repeated recitation gives the sonic-return analogy visible sequence support.

changed_reading.before: Return moves creatures or their answers back to the Lord.
changed_reading.after: The commanded recitation itself can sound the pattern of return: an utterance from Lord-formed knowledge repeats and answers back toward its source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the recycled-residue branch is materially low-register and far from a conventional final-return formulation. It remains anchored in focus `الرجعى`, focus nurture and repair, and the context's created clinging matter; downstream prose should qualify it as a remaking analogy, not a physiological claim or exclusive account of resurrection.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus nurture and repair can act upon the focus branch of matter returned from and reworked after an earlier state.

activation_trace.role: Repair and completion supply the agent who can re-form returned material.
Reheated, reused, or reworked matter supplies a concrete model of return as remaking.
Origination supplies the first transformation against which later re-formation can be imagined.
Thick clinging bodily matter gives the remaking analogy a context-supplied material substrate.

changed_reading.before: The creature returns as an already constituted subject.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the return may include the creature's material being handed back for renewed forming by the same nurturing maker.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it depends on two non-dominant, form-distant split mappings: rising in focus `ر ب ب` and an extended neck under context `ط و ع`. It remains structurally anchored by focus Lordward motion and the explicit lowering-plus-nearness sequence; downstream prose should label it a cross-branch spatial analogy, never a claim that the surface words lexically mean height or neck.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The directional `إلى ربك` and returning motion can host a spatial test of what genuinely counts as approach to the Lord.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant rise and increase image supplies a tempting upward metric for Lordward motion.
Return supplies the reversal by which that apparent spatial metric can be corrected.
The form-distant extended-neck image supplies an erect posture, retained only as a spatial analogy.
Bending the head and bowing reverse the erect posture.
Nearness verifies that lowering, not self-heightening, is the successful approach.

changed_reading.before: Lordward return may be pictured vaguely as ascent toward a higher endpoint.
changed_reading.after: The final sequence inverts that metric: erect self-heightening is not approach, while lowering the head is the motion that becomes nearness.

strongest_changes: Creation, naming, teaching, reading, and pen strengthened return-as-answer into an authored readback rather than a bare transfer.
Attachment followed by claimed self-sufficiency revised return into the re-exposure of dependence, with transgressive overflow supplying an exploratory countercurrent model.
Repeated seeing made the return evidentiary, while the repeated prohibition root turned the attempted stopper's force back toward his own endpoint.
The counter-summons staged return as custody transfer, and the final prostration-plus-approach made the same return voluntarily present as nearness.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained several coexisting mechanisms without disambiguation: sovereign reversion, formative restoration, returned answer, recurrent feedback, coerced retrieval, and willing course correction. The context repeatedly turned outward claims back upon their issuer while preserving the gentler nurture model alongside judgment.
remaining_uncertainties: The primary return branch is strong; auditory, hydrological, recycled-matter, and visual readback branches remain analogical activations rather than secure lexical specifications.
It remains open whether the focus is chiefly universal and eschatological or also intentionally governs the local prohibitor's reversal scene.
The non-dominant split-root images are useful for contained spatial discoveries but are too form-distant to carry an unqualified reading.
